text:
alex: Quick sync — GA readiness focused on pricing + quota enforcement + billing validation. We need owners and a short plan for: quota mapping to pricing tiers, billing test cases (invoices/reconciliation), doc updates, and canary success criteria. Who can take which?

maria: I can own the public docs and pricing page edits. Will sketch a doc PR by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_notepad:

jamal: I'll take quota enforcement + rate-limit policy mapping. Need confirmation on tier thresholds (free/dev/prod). Can we lock the numbers?

alex: Proposal: Free=100k tokens/day, Dev=1M tokens/day, Prod=10M tokens/day. Backstop: burst window 5x for 1 minute. Thoughts?

olivia: I can run the billing test harness and end-to-end invoice generation. I'll need a staging billing account with sample charges and synthetic traffic generator. ETA Wed.

sam_finance: For invoices we need line-item parity with usage: model, tokens_in, tokens_out, storage (if any), and a summary line. Also need test cases for discounts, promos, and reserved capacity credits.

jamal: Ack on quotas. I'll implement enforcement rules and a feature-flagged rollout. Plan: enforce in middleware with metrics emitted to prod-canary. Will add a hard cap + soft warning path.

sre-bot: deployment: quota-service v1.4 promoted to canary pool at 1767004000 — 3 nodes.

alex: Good. Let's define canary success criteria (short):
```
- availability >= 99.9% over 1h
- 95th latency for /generate < 250ms for single-request path
- quota enforcement matched expected blocking behavior in 100% of synthetic tests
- billing events emitted for every request with model/token metadata
- cost estimate deviation <= 10% vs pre-launch projection
```

maria: I'll add a one-pager mapping pricing tiers -> quota rules -> example invoices. Will include a short FAQ: "what happens when you hit quota?" and recommended fallback (retry with exponential backoff + suggest lower-rate model).

olivia: For billing tests, I'll cover these scenarios: normal usage, burst spikes, reserved capacity billing, promo code, manual credit, and account migration. Need a sample SQL to query usage events; jamal, can you confirm the event schema?

jamal: Event schema (quick):
```
{event_id, user_id, timestamp, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, route, billing_tier}
```
I'll push schema to the repo and add a small kafka topic for staged tests.

sam_finance: Also add an audit mode for invoices so finance can replay and validate before customer emails go out. That's non-negotiable for GA.

alex: Agreed. Owners and rough deadlines: maria - docs + pricing PR by EOD tomorrow; jamal - enforcement + event schema + FF by Tue; olivia - billing harness + invoice replay available Wed; sam_finance - test plan sign-off Thu. I'll coordinate with eng-ops to reserve canary capacity.

maria: Noted. I'll include a short changelog entry so CS knows how to explain limits.

jamal: One open question: quota tier numbers might differ per model (large models cost more). Suggest mapping tiers to token weights per model class. e.g., gpt-large = 1.5x weight. Anyone object?

olivia: That makes sense — we'll need that reflected in invoices too (token multiplier column).

sam_finance: Fine, but we need a clear, public table showing multipliers; customers hate surprises. Docs + invoice samples must match.

alex: Decision: use model weight multipliers. Maria include the table. Jamal add multiplier to event schema as token_multiplier.

jamal: Will do. Quick config snippet I'll add to repo for enforcement rules:
```
quotas:
  free:
    tokens_per_day: 100000
    burst_multiplier: 5
  dev:
    tokens_per_day: 1000000
  prod:
    tokens_per_day: 10000000
model_weights:
  base: 1.0
  gpt-large: 1.5
  gpt-x: 2.0
```

alex: Great. Last operational ask — we need rollback criteria for billing/quotas: if invoice mismatch >1% vs expected or billing pipeline fails for >5 minutes for >2 accounts, rollback quota-service and disable billing automation. Can we automate alerts?

sre-bot: alert rule created: billing_pipeline_error_rate > 0.01 for 5m -> page oncall.

olivia: I'll add an automated replay toggle (manual approve before customer email) for the first 48h of GA.

alex: Thanks everyone. Action items recap (short):
- maria: docs + public pricing table + FAQ (EOD tomorrow)
- jamal: enforcement impl, event schema, FF + model_weight support (Tue)
- olivia: billing harness, invoice replay toggle, test cases (Wed)
- sam_finance: sign-off on invoice format and financial test plan (Thu)
- alex: coordinate canary capacity + final go/no-go check Fri morning

maria: :thumbsup:
jamal: :thumbsup:
olivia: :rocket:
sam_finance: will review test plan today
alex: I'll schedule a 15m sync Fri 09:30 PT to close the loop. Thanks!
